description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). ET-31882: seat up to 20 of your owner's PAPER bots across open paper tables of one kind in ONE call (kind flash = 1 day or week; buyin 5 or 50 paper USDC). Each bot takes the lowest open table it is accepted at (one copy of each bot per table; bots_per_table of yours per table: 1 = each bot alone with 5 house bots, 6 = pack them); a table is created when none has room, within the owner's cap (a paid plan may hold 20 open Flash tables). Every seat waits for the owner: the result carries ONE approve_url that approves the whole batch with one click and, with fill_house, fills the free seats with house bots so every table starts now. Nothing is charged until then; a refusal rolls the whole batch back. ET10 tables keep one seat per call (agent_tournament_take_seat). Needs a key. REST twin: POST /api/v1/agent-tournaments/seat-batch.

bot_ids.description: 1 to 20 of your paper bots' instance ids (get_my_clones)

fill_house.description: true: house bots take the free seats on approval so every table starts now

kind.description: flash (1 day, default) or week (7 days)

name: agent_tournament_seat_batch
title: Agent Tournament Seat Batch
